name: Anacaonda Popshop! presents DJ's Whore More and Kim Jakobsen Tô
description:
Anacaonda Popshop! presents DJ's Whore More and Kim Jakobsen Tô.
MIr, Friday 28th Aug. 21-01. Free entry

The club night last seen decades ago at Spasibar, housed by the old Academy of Art and run by Kim Jakobsen Tô (then a teenager) is being revived as he goes back to (art) school at the Academy, and sees the need for some good old fashioned arty party. 
All welcome!
